description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

 About the Role: 
 Help us protect the Security Cloud from the most advanced threats! As a Software Engineer in Product Security, you will be part of a team responsible for developing and deploying security tooling and automation across our Product Security organization. Your team will ensure that our data platforms, operational tools, and security harnesses scale with CrowdStrike’s massive growth and success. You will develop a platform of applications, APIs, and frameworks that allows engineers across Product Security to safeguard our global, multi-cloud production environment! 
 
 What You’ll Do: 
 Be a technical contributor on a global software engineering team in Product Security, building and operating robust and scalable systems that drive our security mission 

 Design and implement software & automation tools for security use cases such as software supply chain security, AI-powered vulnerability discovery, and visibility of a global multi-cloud platform 

 Partner closely with teams throughout Product Security to develop security tooling strategy, through risk assessments and architectural deep dives 

 Own SRE excellence, CICD, and datastore operations for mission-critical security services, implementing performance monitoring and response processes to ensure flawless performance during critical security responses 

 
 What You’ll Need: 
 Experience in a Software Engineering role (event-driven systems, data ingestion pipelines, internal automation tools, internal monitoring tools) 

 Experience developing in Golang, Python, React, Angular, and/or Typescript. 

 In-depth understanding of CI/CD pipelines, containers, software cryptographic signing, and OSS dependencies 

 Experience with data engineering and datastore/queue operations (OpenSearch, Valkey, Postgres, Kafka, SQS, etc.), including technology selection and owning the health, capacity, and maintenance of those systems in production 

 Experience managing end-to-end SDLC, including design, implementation, and delivery, with a focus on stakeholder engagement and mission outcomes 

 Experience with Generative AI, both as a productivity tool and creating services that leverage LLMs
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. 

 Experience with configuration management & orchestration software such as Ansible, Chef, Salt, Puppet, etc. 

 Experience in a Product Security role (product platforms, customer facing applications). SaaS company background is a strong bonus. 

 Broad awareness of the cybersecurity landscape including adversaries, modes of interest, and TTPs 

 Experience monitoring / analyzing telemetry data from applications and infrastructure 

 Experience in Security Operations and/or Incident Response 

 Experience with Cloud-scale, business-critical Linux environments 

 Experience operating within the cloud, preferably AWS or GCP 

 A combination of confidence and independence... with the prudence to know when to ask for help from the rest of the team 

 
 #LI-AM1 
 #LI-Remote
 
 Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike: 
 Market leader in compensation and equity awards

 Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs 

 Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge  

 Paid parental and adoption leaves

 Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

 Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

 Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

 Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe
